watch.summary: A streamer laughs hysterically when a broadcast caster points out a pro Valorant player's abysmal stat line of 6 kills and 19 deaths.

beats.what: Caster highlights a pro player's struggling performance.
Streamer bursts out laughing and exclaims 'Oh my goodness'.
Streamer giggles joyfully as the game continues.

watch.author: mixed
watch.why: The caster's blunt callout of a pro player's atrocious scoreline triggers instant, contagious laughter from the streamer. It works universally because anyone familiar with shooters understands how severe a 6-19 stat line is.
